claim_limitation: This bounded userspace protocol validates the metrics-v6 policy lifecycle telemetry pipeline only. It does not establish kernel scheduler compliance, a causal scheduler-performance improvement, or a CPU-capacity effect.
aggregation_unit: invocation; rows are repeated observations within an invocation and are not independent experimental repetitions
effective_action_scope: S2_effective and action-specific fractions remain conservative observable userspace action-attempt measurements, not Linux dispatch compliance.
burst_metric_scope: S4_burst is an experimental selected-action burst diagnostic. Historical S4 and Q retain their v2/v3 definitions. S4_burst is not a scheduler-performance result and is not included in Q.
policy_scope: Policy mode, generation, persistence, and suppression fields describe the userspace policy lifecycle; they are not kernel controller state.
schema_compatibility_note: v2 through v6 observations must not be silently pooled. v6 is append-only relative to the strict 107-column v5 contract and adds 13 policy lifecycle diagnostics.
protocol_notes: The runner must preserve stdout CSV, stderr, environment, validation report, and metadata for successful, failed, timed-out, and interrupted invocations.
The runner must validate the explicit orchestra.paper_cpu.metrics/v6 identifier and strict 120-column header before summary generation.
The runner must summarize invocations, not individual CSV rows, and must include historical S4 and Q alongside the experimental burst and policy lifecycle fields.

The campaign is a bounded data-pipeline and deterministic-metric validation. Natural host action traces need not contain a controller degradation; synthetic deterministic unit or integration scenarios provide the required semantic coverage.
No invocation uses SCHED_FIFO or requires root privileges.
